services.desc: “Love is in the Air” Book a Marriage Excursion aboard “Impulse” Starting at $299/ duration and rates will be determined on an individual basis Have you always dreamed of having a boat wedding? Seaside Sailing Excursions & Charity Charters in Traverse City, MI can create an intimate marriage ceremony at sea aboard the sailing vessel "Impulse." services.name: Power Island Excursion
services.desc: In these protected waters, civilization seems miles away. About We set sail from the south west end of West Grand Traverse Bay to the destination that I fondly refer to as “Bahamas North” or Power Island. This magical world glistens with aqua blue water so clear that you can view the golden sand 30 feet below. We can set anchor to play in these waters, enjoy a picnic, sip your favorite beverage, and bask in the golden rays of the sun. Or we can simply sail through and enjoy the passing sites as we round the island and continue our journey. The choice and the day are yours. blurb: If taking a charter has been on your bucket list, book your excursion with Seaside Sailing Excursions & Charity Charters. Our company’s owners have a lifelong love of the water and a passion for providing the ultimate sailing experience. We offer various excursions off Traverse City, MI’s beautiful and pristine coast.
